en: A black‑and‑white view over a calm lake bordered by dense coniferous forest. In the foreground, tall pine trees frame the scene from a hillside. Across the water, on a wooded peninsula or shore, stands a large, light-colored building complex with steep roofs, likely a hotel or institutional building, along with a few smaller structures. A small boat is visible on the lake. Handwritten text along the bottom left reads "Tampere: Pyynikki". The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.
